issue.title: docs/getting_started.md still uses overloaded 'explicit-only' Muse/Grok wording missed by muse_documentation_wording plan
issue.description: docs/getting_started.md:68 says muse and grok are 'explicit-only and never auto-detected', the same conflated phrasing that sase/repos/plans/202608/muse_documentation_wording.md corrected everywhere else (README.md, INSTALL.md, docs/llms.md, docs/agent_providers.md, docs/configuration.md, docs/xprompt.md, and both blog posts under docs/blog/posts/). That plan's file list did not include docs/getting_started.md, so this occurrence was left stale. Should get the same treatment: state plainly that Muse/Grok are never auto-detected (separate fact from alias-pool routing), without changing provider autodetection or model-alias pool behavior.

payload.close_reason: Fixed: docs/getting_started.md no longer contains 'explicit-only' anywhere. Line 71 now states the fact plainly and separately -- 'SASE never auto-detects `muse` or `grok`' -- with alias-pool routing described independently at lines 73-77, which is the treatment the muse_documentation_wording plan applied elsewhere. Verified 2026-08-24 at 45806495f.
